name: AI Tech Viral

sources.title: Submit page — renders 'Log in to Submit' with Google OAuth only
AI Tech Viral homepage — trending AI tools directory

requirements: AI tools directory — product should be an AI tool
Google account sign-in is mandatory before the submission form is shown
preparation: Tool name, URL, description, logo, and category
workflow: Log in with Google (redirect /api/auth/google?redirect=/submit) or create an account via /signup
Complete the post-login submission form (not publicly visible)
watchFor: No pricing or guidelines page is public; the form is entirely behind the login wall
Site shares an identical template/category set with several sister directories (unitelist.com, appalist.com, weliketools.com, aixcollection.com) and runs a SubmitSaaS ad — expect cross-site upsells
Whether listing is free or paid could not be verified without logging in
countsAsLive: Tool page appears on aitechviral.com under /latest or its category and is reachable without login
unknowns: Whether submission is free or paid after login
Form fields, review process, and turnaround time
Whether a badge or backlink is required
